$comment: Ad copy and file list for the /ad-kit/ page. Edit the text here, run `npm run verify`, commit and push to main. Images and videos are made by `node marketing/ads/make-ads.cjs` into marketing/ads/out/; each idea's id matches the file names nexascan-<id>-<size>.jpg / .mp4. path is the page on the site the ad links to, campaign its utm_campaign, hash an optional #section. Wording rules: docs/ADS-AND-CAMPAIGNS.md.

ideas.name: Smart Redact
ideas.title: Sending a payslip? Hide the private bits first.
ideas.why: The strongest hook: an everyday worry, shown being solved. Start here.
ideas.primary: Sending a payslip, bank statement or ID copy? NexaScan's Smart Redact finds names, addresses, account and ID numbers for you to review, then hides them for real before you share. Done on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.
ideas.headline: Hide personal details before you share

ideas.name: PDF editor
ideas.title: Edit any PDF. Right on your phone.
ideas.why: A broad, everyday need. Signing is free, so it brings in new users.
ideas.primary: Sign a contract, fill in a form or mark up a PDF without a computer. NexaScan lets you write, draw and sign, tick, cross or date a form, and add shapes, arrows and watermarks. Every edit is saved as a new copy, so your original stays as it was.
ideas.headline: Edit and sign PDFs on your phone

ideas.name: Nexa Magic
ideas.title: Creased, stained, faded? Fixed in one tap.
ideas.why: A before-and-after people stop scrolling for. Good for older audiences and family records.
ideas.primary: That old letter, receipt or certificate, creased and stained? Nexa Magic repairs folds, creases, stains and yellowed paper on your phone, so your scan looks better than the paper.
ideas.headline: Fix creased, stained pages

ideas.name: Remove Watermark
ideas.title: Brush once. The stamp is gone.
ideas.why: A striking wipe. Keep the "your own documents" framing.
ideas.primary: Brush over a stamp, a DRAFT mark or pen scribbles once. NexaScan finds similar marks across the page and cleans them away, keeping your text. For your own drafts and forms.
ideas.headline: Remove stamps and pen marks

ideas.name: Scan, Edit & Redact
ideas.title: One app for every document job.
ideas.why: The brand message. Use it in a carousel next to one feature ad, or for retargeting.
ideas.primary: Scan it, edit it, redact it. NexaScan is an AI document studio with 25 tools that run on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. No account, and your documents are never uploaded.
ideas.headline: AI Scan, Edit & Redact

ideas.name: Private by design
ideas.title: Your documents never leave your phone.
ideas.why: A trust message for people wary of cloud scanners. Works well as a second ad to the same audience.
ideas.primary: Your payslips, IDs and contracts are nobody else's business. NexaScan runs every tool on your device, even in flight mode, so nothing is uploaded. No account, no ads, no watermark on your files.
ideas.headline: Private by design
